scope: Root-free nonterminal state after unit propagation and before/after the exact 2-SAT eligibility check, inside the frozen N^2 state envelope.

definitions.k_ab: number of clauses containing a particular nondegenerate cooccurring sign-aware literal pair (a,b)
definitions.T: maximum k_ab over all pair candidates

lemma_1_pair_candidate_exists_after_2sat.statement: At a unit-propagation fixed point, if the residual is nonterminal and solve_2sat_exact returns None, all_or_pair_candidates is nonempty.
proof: No unit or empty clause remains at the fixed point.
solve_2sat_exact returns a decision object whenever every clause has width at most 2.
Therefore rejection by the 2-SAT eligibility guard implies at least one clause has width at least 3.
Canonical clauses contain no duplicate/complementary copy of one underlying variable, so any width>=3 clause contains a nondegenerate literal pair.
all_or_pair_candidates deterministically enumerates every such cooccurring pair.

lemma_2_exact_macro_size_upper.statement: For a pair occurring in k_ab clauses, apply_or_pair_v2 returns a canonical macro CNF with state_units <= s+10-k_ab.
proof: Before canonical cleanup, the k_ab replaced clauses remain k_ab clauses but each loses the two pair literals and gains one fresh -e literal, reducing literal count by exactly k_ab.
The definitional extension adds exactly three clauses of widths 2,2,3: +3 clauses and +7 literal occurrences.
canon_cnf can only remove duplicate/subsumed clauses or tautologies and cannot increase the representation, so canonical output is <=s+10-k_ab.

theorem.name: V3_OR_PAIR_MACRO_HEADROOM_ADMISSION
theorem.statement: If there exists a pair with k_ab >= max(1,10-H), then at least one frozen v3 OR-pair macro candidate fits the same N^2 state cap. In particular, if H>=9 (equivalently s<=N^2-9), every nonterminal root-free state that reaches the v3 eligibility region has at least one cap-admissible OR-pair macro.
proof: By Lemma 1 at least one candidate has k_ab>=1 after 2-SAT rejection.
By Lemma 2 a pair with k_ab>=10-H has macro size <=s+10-k_ab<=s+H=N^2.
If H>=9 then max(1,10-H)=1, so any candidate suffices.

near_cap_failure_band.statement: If every v3 OR-pair macro exceeds N^2, necessarily H<=8 and T<=9-H. Equivalently the state lies in the final nine units below the cap and every cooccurring literal pair is too dispersed to recover the missing headroom.

interaction_with_other_v3_results.extension_cap: Already proved not to be an independent v2/v3 total macro-count barrier under the frozen N definition.
interaction_with_other_v3_results.step_count: Every successful v3 atomic plan decreases live-variable count by at least one; successful tail length is polynomial.
interaction_with_other_v3_results.remaining_main_problem: After a cap-admissible macro exists, prove existence of two distinct pre-macro old pivots whose sequential exact eliminations both stay within N^2, or find a reachable counterexample.

next_exact_target: Condition on a cap-admissible macro and derive an exact two-pivot elimination sandwich. The only separate macro-cap obstruction left is the proved near-cap sparse-pair band H<=8 and T<=9-H.
